extensionDescription.message: Tree-style tab management for the native vertical tab strip: collapsible subtrees, close-with-children, and drag-to-nest.

commandToggleCollapsed.message: Collapse or expand the current tab's subtree

commandCloseTree.message: Close the current tab and its whole subtree

commandOutdent.message: Promote the current tab one level

commandIndent.message: Nest the current tab under the previous sibling

indentHint.message: How far each child level is pushed in

indentGuidesHint.message: Faint lines that connect children to their parent

hiddenTabCountHint.message: Badge after the title of a collapsed parent showing the number of tabs inside

animationsHint.message: Glide on collapse, expand and re-parent (also off when Windows animations are off)

themeHighlightHint.message: Otherwise use the colour on the right

plusOpensChild.message: The + button opens a child tab

plusOpensChildHint.message: Off: new tabs always start a new tree

askClosingTreeHint.message: When closing a tab would close at least this many descendants (0 = never ask)

nativeUnavailableDetail.message: version.dll is not installed or has no offsets for this Chrome build; tabs stay unchanged.

backgroundNoAnswer.message: The background worker did not answer.

closeGenericQuestion.message: Close this tab and its descendants?

closeOneQuestion.message: Close this tab and its 1 descendant?

closeManyQuestion.message: Close this tab and its $1 descendants?
